candidates.requirement: Continue parsing a number across multiple calls on one tokener so saved exponent state is reconstructed.
candidates.target_route: Supply chunks "[0", "e+", then "-]" to successive json_tokener_parse_ex calls on one tokener.
candidates.failure_condition: The entry calls json_tokener_parse_ex only once, then frees the tokener, so no input can reach the saved-state branch.
candidates.alternative_paths: A one-call input may produce the same final error, but cannot exercise continuation of the same tokener state; the complete entry contains no second parse call.

candidates.requirement: Exercise the parser's supported strict-mode rejection of an incomplete exponent.
candidates.target_route: Set JSON_TOKENER_STRICT on a tokener and parse "[0e]".
candidates.failure_condition: The entry never sets flags; the calloc-initialized flags remain zero, selecting permissive trimming instead of strict rejection.
candidates.alternative_paths: Other input bytes cannot set tokener flags, and the complete entry has no configuration or equivalent strict-mode call route.

before.requirement: Reject the specified malformed exponent after reconstructing number state across the chunks "[0", "e+", and "-]".
before.reason: The complete old number state has no saved-exponent reconstruction. Its general incremental parsing is a different obligation from this corrected chunked outcome.

after.requirement: Continue parsing the specified chunks on one tokener and reject the misplaced minus using reconstructed exponent state.
after.reason: The added saved-state check makes this behavior available, but the harness frees the tokener after its sole parse call.

source_evidence.quote:
* Fix incremental parsing of numbers, especially those with exponents, e.g.
   so parsing "[0", "e+", "-]" now properly returns an error.

claims.reason: The old source supported general incremental parsing, but the frozen tuple is the corrected error for this exponent sequence. That behavior is required only after the added reconstruction.

before.requirement: Reject "[0e]" specifically because strict mode disallows a missing exponent.
before.reason: The complete old number path has no strict-mode missing-exponent check; its strict handling here concerns leading zeroes.

after.requirement: With JSON_TOKENER_STRICT set, reject "[0e]" as an incomplete exponent.
after.reason: Strict mode bypasses permissive trimming and the added case specifies a number error; the harness has no flag-setting call.
